note: [v6:rebuild] The fish-market rebuild spec: every dimension the app builds for the C棟 roof deck (harbor/market5.js) and the north-facility quay hall (harbor/market4.js), from the photo survey (data/survey/market/features.json, docs/anime/survey/market.md). Deck positions are in the penthouse-wall frame: s = metres along the east wall from the frame origin (south-south-east, +), off = metres out from the wall face (east, +); ENU = o + s*u + off*n. Heights are T.P. metres unless named h (above the deck). Sources per block in `src`.

deck.src: deck.y (survey adjustment, eye heights + bridge pylon); the east parapet rail runs right behind the pavilions (seen through their glazing in IMG_0793 / 0798; the GSI / Earth top view's bright parapet line at off 21.3): off 23.2, 0.6 m clear of pair 3; the strip east of it is a lower roof the photos never see (they look over the rail at the bay)

rail.src: IMG_0797 / 0798 / 0793: a 0.45 m concrete upstand with a 1.1 m galvanised rail

windows.src: 24 centres measured on the wall plane (deck.window#1-24, IMG_0792 / 0795 / 0798) and nothing else is built. The earlier build added six by the 14.4 m triplet period (30 windows): the triplet at s 6-14 is plain wall in IMG_0792 (every other window there shows as a dark strip), and the one at s 109-117 is visible in IMG_0794 but only at the frame edge at a grazing angle (a ray cut of its windows is 4-5 m off), so its positions are not measured and it is left out; count 24

wall.src: wall line, base and top: deck.wall.* (survey adjustment, GSI lot corners); windows: 1.95 x 1.64 m measured on the wall plane in IMG_0792 (six windows) and IMG_0795 (two), centres in triplets every ~14.5 m (deck.window#1-24); vents: IMG_0792 / 0795 above each triplet's middle window; letters: deck.letter.1-7 (2.4 m glyphs, IMG_0795); entrance: deck.entrance.* and IMG_0795 cuts; raised roof sections behind the parapet with rounded white end caps: IMG_0792 (s 50.8-71.0, front edge T.P. 22.9 = h 7.3), IMG_0794 / 0795 (s 99.5-117.4, h 7.1-7.6), each cut 1 m behind the wall face; the entrance landing (0.3 m step) and its two handrails cut on the deck / the rail line in IMG_0795

penthouse.src: GSI / Earth top: the upper floor fills C棟 from its west edge (off -32) to the east wall

studio.src: deck.studio.* (survey adjustment; studio face = GSI line shifted by studio_off), louvre box corners, lamp panels (IMG_0794 / 0796 / 0798); door from deck.studio.door (cut on the face plane in IMG_0794 / 0796 / 0798), its canopy flush with the face (canopy corners off 1.43 / 5.31, T.P. 18.68-19.15)

pavilions.src: 6.6 m wide, 8.3 m long (#6 6.9 m): #4 from IMG_0793 (SW corner s 73.56 / off 13.7, south face 6.6 m wide, plinth 0.79 / glass 2.1 / fascia 2.5 / raised roof end 3.6-3.8 m, cut on the measured face plane); pair 3 (#5, #6) from an edge fit of the well-registered IMG_0794 / 0796 / 0798 (best west face off 16, #5 north end s 94-95; #6 south end s 114.5 from its corner seen in all three, north end bounded by the stack S56 in the gap); IMG_0797 is not used (its pose is held only by its GPS fix: the cactus's plate cuts 7 m apart in IMG_0796 and IMG_0797, and the two photos' distances to it break the triangle inequality); pairs 1, 2, 4 centred on the GSI ortho (deck.pavilion#1-3, #7, #8, sigma 1.5 m), #8 from the roof's curl tip triangulated in IMG_0794 / 0796 / 0798 (s 156.25 +- 0.8, off 14.0) combined with the ortho centre (s 159.7 +- 1.5): centre s 153.8, south end 3 m short of the studio face (the ortho centre alone put an 8.3 m pavilion 3 m into the studio); outer (swept-up) ends alternate N / S within each pair (IMG_0793, 0797)

stacks.src: S67 (IMG_0796 x 0798, 3.0 / 1.6 px); S56 cut at the measured tip height on its IMG_0796 bearing (in the gap between #5 and #6, as IMG_0797 shows it); the two stacks south of #4 cut at that height on their IMG_0793 bearings (the one behind the lifeboat stands beyond it, tip T.P. 21.2); the mid-pair stacks of pairs 1, 2, 4 and the one after pair 1 by the pattern

lifeboat.src: [v6:fix2] the sheer edge (the navy rub rail) cut at its own height 1.07 in IMG_0793: s 84.5 / off 13.52 at the left end of the visible line, s 88.32 / off 13.76 at the frame edge, so the flank is at off 13.6 and the axis 3.6 deg off the wall line; the boat is 2.3 m wide (stencil 5.30 x 2.30 x 1.00), so its centreline stands at off 14.75 and the bow dome starts at s 84.0 (the first version put the boat 2.9 m too far north and 1.3 m too far east, and its end-on form was wrong: the photo shows its west flank, the stern notch toward the camera); the tower window edge cut at 2.23: s 86.5, off 14.25-14.97; trailer ends n / s are the deck picks of IMG_0793 (the trailer's frame, the stern end of the boat is cut by the frame edge)

sorter.src: [v6:fix3] the sorter at the conveyor's head cut in IMG_0855 (head fully in frame): its left casters (68.06 / 68.18, the survey's), left end 67.6-67.8, grate top T.P. 3.63 (floor + 1.48), channel top 2.8-2.9; 1.4 m wide between its casters' lines (the fix2 box, a 66-70 x d -24..-20.2, was twice as long and 2.7x as wide as the head in the photo)

hall.src: the north facility's quay hall as the five dawn frames (IMG_0853-0861, 06:53) see it with the re-solved cameras (camera 5.0 m above the hall floor, 48 m from the quay edge, on the 2F gallery by the land wall; the truck's plate and wheelbase, the tub rows' 1.44 x 1.19 m rims and the quay line fix the scale, tools/survey/market_adjust.py canopy). Floor items are cut on their plane (tools/survey/market_hall.py, data/survey/market/hall-picks.json; the two camera stands agree to 0.01-0.05 m). Overhead: the lower edge of the transverse beam is fitted from both stands (a 59.7, bottom T.P. 7.76); the longitudinal beams are the one-parameter family along the quay (the stands' baseline runs along them): bottom 7.7 at d -34.3 / -27.7, the column girder 7.55 and the edge beam 7.2 from the line of the roof edge's shadow on the floor (d -34.5, 14.5 deg sun): roof edge at d -19.8. The shed outline is moved 7.5 m inland (the OSM way is traced on a roof 13 m up: relief displacement); the column grid is 21.6 m (a 14.4 m grid would put column 8 in the middle of IMG_0855 / 0861, where there is none; 21.6 m puts the next column on the measured transverse beam, a 59.7, and out of every frame); the floor falls smoothly from T.P. 2.15 to the apron's 1.84 (the tie points and the unbroken wet floor in IMG_0853 / 0855: no step); the ceiling slab is at T.P. 11.2: the near face of the transverse girder (a 59.7) fills IMG_0853 / 0861 up to the top of the frame, 10.5 m up at its nearest, so the beams are 3.5-4 m deep girders hanging from it

vessel.src: the white 20-30 m vessel 「KD1-875」 berthed at the curb (IMG_0853 / 0855 / 0861): sheer, deckhouse top and funnel-fin tip cut on the hull-side plane d = +2 (3.5 / 5.65 / 7.7 above T.P. 0), deckhouse a 84-95, stern out of every frame (assumed at a 62), bow at a 98.5; a simplified hull and house, no rigging; the white deckhouse with the windows spans a 89.5-95 (IMG_0855 u 1700-2300), the lower deck and gear forward of it top out at 4.7

hall.edgeFit: [v6:fix3] NOT adopted: tools/survey/hall_fit.py puts the edge beam's lower edge on the family y = 7.16 + 0.0409 (d + 47.7) (5.7 px instead of 16.5 px over the five frames at d -19.8 / y 8.30; with the shadow line d -34.52 it picks d -16.3 / T.P. 8.44), but the beams in front (long[0], long[1], d -34 / -32) hide that line from every dawn frame: moving it changes no pixel of the app's edge maps, so there is nothing in the frames to confirm it and the fix 2 build (d -19.8 / 7.20) stays
hall.ceilingFit: [v6:fix2] tools/survey/hall_fit.py: the longitudinal members run along the dawn stands' baseline, so the frames fix only a family (d, bottom) for each; long[1] is moved to where the frames' edges are (the metric's Canny): d -27.7 -> -32.07, bottom 7.70 -> 6.92 (4.6 px instead of 20.8 px at the 1080 frame). Held: the transverse beams at the surveyed 7.76 (canopy.beam_t1.y), the column girder on its columns, the slab at 11.2 and the edge beam (its height is tied to the surveyed shadow line canopy.shadow_d; the frames' edges would put it 1.1 m higher, which the shadow does not allow)
hall.vesselFitNote: [v6:fix2] tried: tools/survey/vessel_fit.py moved the four vessel components by about -1.2 m along the quay (and the hull top +1 m) and cut their wireframe edge distance by a third, but the 5 frames' chamfer did not improve (+0.1 px): not adopted, the first-build vessel (hull-side plane d +2, cut in 3 frames) stays
